about: The reach head, its derivation, its canonical bytes and digest, the boot's resolution of a deployment's reach settings, the compose selections, the name grammars and the words a person reads. Cyfr.RuntimeConfig (Elixir) generates every canonical, digest, class and boot answer; apps/codex/internal/reach (Go) agrees with them. The derive vectors' .env assignments and removals are Go's alone.
